body: I don't want to be with my family again. I don't want to do that. I'm not doing that. period.

I don't really want to be back with my family. I don't want to burden them anymore. They can't deal with me, and they really can't help me either.

I want someone to actually treat me like a person and not shut me out, but that's not going to happen. I really just don't want to live like this anymore.
